# Local Markdown dependencies

- Marked 16.4.2 (`marked.mjs`), MIT: https://github.com/markedjs/marked
- DOMPurify 3.2.7 (`purify.mjs`), Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify

Vendored from the versioned npm distributions on jsDelivr. License files are included. The comparison page loads these files locally and needs no external CDN at runtime.
